name: Question 15
worked_solution:
We need to solve the equation $Ax=0.$ First, we find the row echelon form of $A$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}-3 & 9 & -9 \\ 6 & -18 & 18 \\ 3 & -8 & 9\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :=-\frac{1}{3}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -3 & 3 \\ 6 & -18 & 18 \\ 3 & -8 & 9\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-6){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -3 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 3 & -8 & 9\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-3){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -3 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & ↔{R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -3 & 3 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

This corresponds to the following system:

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2}+3{x}_{3}=0 \\ {x}_{2}=0 \\ 0=0\end{aligned}
$$

The basic variables are the variables whose coefficients are pivots. In this case, the basic variables are ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}$, and we have one free variable, ${x}_{3}.$ That means we need to find ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}$ in terms of ${x}_{3}.$

The second equation tells us that ${x}_{2}=0.$ Substituting this into the first equation, we get 

$$
{x}_{1}-3(0)+3{x}_{3}=0\,⟹\,{x}_{1}=-3{x}_{3}.
$$

So the set of all the solutions of $Ax=0$ is

$$
\text{Null}(A)={[\begin{aligned}-3{x}_{3} \\ 0 \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}]\,:\,{x}_{3}\in R}.
$$

Question 15

Consider the matrix A=[−39−96−18183−89]. Find Null(A).

a
{[−3x3x3x3]:x3∈R}
b
{0}
c
{[3x30x3]:x3∈R}
d
{[−3x30x3]:x3∈R}
e
{[3x3x3x3]:x3∈R}
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

We need to solve the equation Ax=0. First, we find the row echelon form of A as follows:

A=[−39−96−18183−89]R1:=−13R1∼[1−336−18183−89]R2:=R2+(−6)R1∼[1−330003−89]R3:=R3+(−3)R1∼[1−33000010]R2↔R3∼[1−33010000]

This corresponds to the following system:

{x1−3x2+3x3=0x2=00=0

The basic variables are the variables whose coefficients are pivots. In this case, the basic variables are x1 and x2, and we have one free variable, x3. That means we need to find x1 and x2 in terms of x3.

The second equation tells us that x2=0. Substituting this into the first equation, we get

x1−3(0)+3x3=0⟹x1=−3x3.

So the set of all the solutions of Ax=0 is

Null(A)={[−3x30x3]:x3∈R}.
